blocks.text: 20vi sadi ke shuru mein naye tajurbon aur hisab se pata chala ke Newton ke laws par chalne wali classical physics bohat chhote particles ya bohat tez velocities wale waqiaat ko nahi samjha sakti. Is se relativistic mechanics bani, jo classical mechanics se zyada wasee dhancha (framework) deti hai aur jis ne kainat ke baare mein hamari soch badal di. Albert Einstein ki Special Theory of Relativity (1905) ne yeh masle hal kiye: us ne kaha ke physics ke laws har observer (dekhne wale) ke liye ek jaise hain aur light ki speed constant hai, observer chahe jaise bhi chal raha ho. Is theory ne classical mechanics aur electromagnetic theory ka takraao khatam kiya aur time, space aur motion ki samajh badal di; yahi aaj ki modern physics ki bunyad hai. Is chapter mein hum dekhenge ke Einstein ki theory ne kainat ke baare mein hamara nazariya kaise badla.

Socho aap gend apne daen (right) taraf phenkte hain. Aap ke saamne munh kar ke khare shakhs ko yahi simt us ki baen (left) taraf lagti hai. Yani simt (direction) relative hai, dekhne wale par depend karti hai. Isi tarah koi cheez ruki hui hai ya chal rahi hai, yeh bhi observer par depend karta hai. Misal: chalti train ki deewarein andar baithe musafiron ko ruki hui lagti hain, magar zameen par khare shakhs ko chalti hui. Is liye hum yaqeen se nahi keh sakte ke koi cheez bilkul (absolutely) ruki hui hai ya chal rahi hai; har harkat observer ya us ke frame of reference (jis ke hisab se naapa jaye) ke nisbat (relative) hai. Ek misal se yeh wazeh hota hai: band train ke dabbe mein baitha observer dabbe ko apna frame of reference banata hai. Train ki harkat jaanne ke liye woh gend girata hai aur gend ka horizontal (sideways) faasla naapta hai; har dafa oonchai (vertical faasla) ek jaisi rakhi jati hai. Farz hai ke har soorat mein gend “t” seconds mein farsh tak pohanchti hai.

Train ruki hui hai. Is soorat mein gend ki horizontal velocity zero hai aur horizontal faasla bhi zero. Andar wala observer aur bahar wala shakhs dono ek hi cheez dekhte hain: gend usi point ke bilkul neeche farsh par girti hai jahan se chhori gayi thi (Fig. 11.1-a).

blocks.alt: Do aik jaise ruke hue train ke dabbe. Har ek mein aadmi haath aage kar ke gend chhorta hai jo seedhi neeche farsh par girti hai (nuqte). Labels: Observer in the train; Observer outside the train.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.1(a): Train ke andar aur train ke bahar observer (train ruki hui) (kitab ki Figure 11.1(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Train ruki hui hai, is liye chhorte waqt gend ki koi sideways speed nahi. Woh sirf gravity se girti hai aur haath ke bilkul neeche farsh par lagti hai. Andar wala aur bahar wala dono ek jaisa seedha girna dekhte hain, kyun ke koi bhi train ke nisbat harkat mein nahi.

Train uniform (yaksan) velocity vₒ se chal rahi hai. Chhorte waqt gend ki bhi horizontal velocity vₒ hoti hai, is liye woh projectile (phenki hui cheez) ki tarah chalti hai. Farsh tak pohanchne ke waqt t mein woh horizontal faasla vₒt tay karti hai. Train aur andar wala observer bhi usi velocity vₒ se chal rahe hain, is liye woh bhi usi waqt t mein utna hi faasla vₒt tay karte hain. Chunancha andar wale ko gend chhorne wali jagah ke bilkul neeche girti dikhti hai. Magar train ke bahar wala observer gend ko projectile raste (curve) par girta dekhta hai, jaisa Fig. 11.1(b) mein hai. Yani ek doosre ke nisbat uniform velocity se chalne wale frames ke observers ek hi harkat ko mukhtalif dekhte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: v0 se chalta dabba; andar gend haath ke neeche seedhi girti hai (Observer in the moving train). Daen: chhorne ke waqt dabba dashed aur waqt t baad solid, v0 t aage; bahar se gend kham-daar dashed raste par haath ke neeche farsh par girti dikhti hai (Observer outside the moving train).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.1(b): Chalti train ke andar aur bahar observer (kitab ki Figure 11.1(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chhorne se pehle gend train ke saath vₒ se aage chal rahi hoti hai, aur use koi peeche nahi dhakelta, is liye girte hue bhi us ki aage ki speed vₒ hi rehti hai. Baen tasveer: aap bhi vₒ se aage chal rahe hain, is liye gend sirf neeche jati dikhti hai. Daen tasveer: zameen par khara shakhs do harkatein ek saath dekhta hai, aage vₒ aur neeche girna, jo mil kar curve (projectile rasta) banati hain. Dono bayan durust hain; sirf frame of reference alag hai.

blocks.prompt: Har harkat relative hai. Relativistic mechanics kin cheezon ke liye classical mechanics se mukhtalif nateeje deti hai?
blocks.explanation: Un cheezon ke liye jo light ki speed ke qareeb speed se chal rahi hon. Rozmarra (aam) speeds par dono ek jaise nateeje deti hain; farq sirf bohat tez speeds par numayan hota hai.

items: Newton ki physics bohat chhote particles aur bohat tez speeds par kaam nahi karti; Einstein ki special theory (1905): physics ke laws har observer ke liye ek jaise aur light ki speed constant.
Rest aur motion relative hain. Uniform velocity se chalti train mein giri gend andar wale ko seedhi neeche, bahar wale ko projectile raste par girti dikhti hai (Fig. 11.1).
